fixes.recommendedFix: Use a title template ('%s | Stockstrail') and remove '| Stockstrail' from per-page titles, or set an absolute title on pages that already contain the brand.

fixes.issue: Your sheet and the live site disagree on some metadata.
fixes.evidence: About live title: 'About Us | Stockstrail — Founder, Certifications & Our Approach'; Blog live title: 'Financial Insights & Investment Strategies Blog | Stockstrail | Stockstrail'. Your sheet lists different values.
fixes.recommendedFix: Confirm which version is deployed, purge CDN/ISR cache, then treat the final sheet as the single source of truth.

fixes.issue: Gated pages are indexable and carry the home-page description.
fixes.evidence: /sign-in and /complete-profile are 'index, follow' with inherited root meta (your sheet).
fixes.recommendedFix: Set robots to noindex,nofollow and remove both from the XML sitemap.

fixes.evidence: Blog #5: 'Stockstrail-Mutual-Funds-Chapter-4 | Stockstrail'.
fixes.recommendedFix: Replace with the new title (see Meta - Main Site).

fixes.recommendedFix: Rewrite as a 'how to add a nominee now' guide, re-verify against the SEBI circular, add 'Last updated'.

fixes.issue: Fee and commission claims contradict your own disclosure.
fixes.evidence: SIP calculator page: '100% Free Advice', 'zero distributor markups', 'Direct AMC Execution', 'zero advisory fees', 'Zero-commission direct AMC investment', footer 'unbiased advice'. Home disclosure: 'we receive commissions from AMCs'. MF page FAQ: Regular plans include distribution expenses.
fixes.recommendedFix: Make every page consistent with the commission disclosure. Remove absolute claims ('zero', 'unbiased', 'top-performing'). Have a compliance professional review.

fixes.issue: Titles such as 'advisor', 'SEBI-certified' and a 'SEBI Registered' label may mislead.
fixes.evidence: About page: label 'SEBI Registered' beside a SEBI Investor Certification exam certificate; 'SEBI-Certified Advisor'; footer 'Founder & Principal Advisor'; 'certified financial advisor'.
fixes.recommendedFix: You are an AMFI-registered mutual fund distributor (ARN-284122). An exam certificate is not SEBI registration. Use 'AMFI-registered mutual fund distributor' and have compliance confirm whether 'advisor/advisory' wording is acceptable. I am not a lawyer; please verify.
